skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 180% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turns (adds bonus Injured DMG equal to 10% ATK when the target is attacked).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turns (adds bonus Injured DMG equal to 10% ATK when the target is attacked).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20% HP. When deployed together with Bitterworm, DMG is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +30% HP. When deployed together with Bitterworm, DMG is increased by 30%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +35% HP. When deployed together with Bitterworm, DMG is increased by 35%.
